svg.text: Who decides what
Agents make the judgement calls. Anything that must never go wrong is code. Anything that is a family's choice goes to the parent.
The agents judge
eight Strands agents, each with its own model setting
Is this upload fine for this family?
Curator
What to ask, and at which second
Planner
Was that answer right, and what to say back
Buddy
What a parent should hear about today
Digest
What a channel really publishes, and whether
it has started to drift
Reviewer
Drafts of household questions and break
lines, for the parent to edit and save
Coach
Answers about one video, from its transcript,
and says so when it cannot tell
Explainer
How hard the next round of a game is, and
what Gilli says as it starts
Playmate
A model call that fails falls back to a fixed, safe answer.
The code enforces
rules no model is asked about, and none can overrule
Alarming words and live streams are hidden
for everyone; over 35 minutes needs a parent
Only approved videos reach a child; a child's
search never reaches YouTube
Question types and spacing for each age band;
no text at all for ages 5–6
Daily minutes and breaks; a parent PIN to
leave kid mode
"Allow all" never lets through what Gilli
kept back
Three link checks a day per household
Nothing a child says is stored: only a score
and a ten-word paraphrase
The official YouTube embed: ads untouched,
nothing drawn over a playing video
Five rounds a game, a cap a day; where Gilli
hides is picked in code, never by a model
The parent decides
asked only when it is genuinely their call
What is fine in this house: a few questions,
each one skippable
What the child likes, and what to do at a
break
Every video Gilli asked about, and any verdict
they disagree with, either way
Allowing one checked video, or a whole
channel
The words Gilli says at a break, and whether
the break is firm
What to do about a drifting channel; HeyGilli
never removes one on its own
The daily limit, and how long a break lasts
The child sees only the result
Approved videos on a shelf, Gilli's voice at a natural break, pictures or words to suit their age, and a break with something to do.
No search, no recommendations, no verdicts, and no text at all for a 5-year-old. Between videos, two short games with Gilli.
